comments.comment: 6:13 I've never been to a gym I just work out with dumbbells while I watch TV after dinner then have another meal after the workout 6 days a week. So before dinner if it's a top of the body workout I'll do pushups then eat dinner then start with weights while watching tv for 2 - 3 hours, if it's a lower body workout I'll do sit ups before dinner, eat then start with weights for 2-3 hours while watching tv.  I'll stop for a bit to do the washing up, put on a clothes wash etc. Somedays I go harder than others depending on how my body feels on that particular day so Monday, Wednesday, Friday is upper body workout and Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday is lower body workout. This has been my routine for a long time since 30 years old now I'm nearly 50. So get rid of the sofa\couch and replace with some dumbbells and kettlebells, resistance bands and a yoga mat etc. You don't have to go super hard like in the gym either but don't sit down until you've finished the workout.
